Bono East Region

Bono East

Sitting near the middle of the country, Bono East rewards the traveller who turns a through-route into a proper stop.

Kintampo Waterfalls · Photo: Cdilalo47

Capital

Techiman

Go for

Kintampo, caves, waterfalls and road trips

Good to know

The Kintampo Falls area is one of the region’s best-known stops.

    One of the biggest produce markets in the country.

Festivals in
Bono East.

Festivals and cultural events kept here, in calendar order. Many dates move from year to year, so each festival’s page has what we know about when.

  • Mar–Apr

    Apoo

    A week when people may sing out their grievances against chiefs and leaders, to cleanse the town.

    Usually March or April; dates varyTechiman and Wenchi

  • Oct

    Fofie

    A yam festival of thanks for the harvest, ending in a durbar of chiefs carried through the streets.

    OctoberTechiman, and Nchiraa near Wenchi
